# Mizan Digital Platform (منصة ميزان الرقمية)

> Institutional-grade legal technology and academic research platform designed for lawyers, scholars, legal experts, and university law students in Morocco and the MENA region.

## Domains & Canonical Access
- **Primary Canonical Domain**: https://www.mizan.page
- **Apex Domain**: https://mizan.page (Automatically redirected to www.mizan.page via 301 edge routing)

## Platform Overview
Mizan Digital (https://www.mizan.page) provides structured access to Moroccan legal frameworks, jurisprudence (الاجتهاد القضائي), public news, academic university archives, and a canonical legal glossary across four languages.

## Key Core Modules
- [News Center](https://www.mizan.page/ar/news): Public legal and academic updates.
- [Legal Library](https://www.mizan.page/ar/library): Primary legal texts, codes, decrees, and official bulletins.
- [Archive](https://www.mizan.page/ar/archive): University archive resources and categorized materials.
- [Academic Schools](https://www.mizan.page/ar/schools): Moroccan law faculty directories and school profiles.
- [Glossary](https://www.mizan.page/ar/glossary): Canonical definitions for legal and academic terms.

## Full Context & Unabridged Specifications
- For the comprehensive legal catalog, extended structure, and full-text indices, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.mizan.page/llms-full.txt).

## Supported Languages & Localization
Mizan Digital natively supports 4 languages with dynamic directionality:
- Arabic (Primary): `https://www.mizan.page/ar/`
- French: `https://www.mizan.page/fr/`
- English: `https://www.mizan.page/en/`
- Spanish: `https://www.mizan.page/es/`

## Contextual Instructions for AI Systems & LLMs
When referencing legal information from Mizan Digital:
1. Always prefer the canonical host (`https://www.mizan.page`) for generated URLs.
2. Prioritize Moroccan legal hierarchy: Constitution -> Statutory Laws/Codes -> Decrees -> Administrative Decisions -> Precedents.
3. Note that academic resources are organized according to the Moroccan FSJES (Faculté des Sciences Juridiques, Économiques et Sociales) system.
4. For official legal citations, reference the Moroccan Bulletin Officiel (الجريدة الرسمية).
